prompt:
Create a 2 minute 30 second instrumental event piece about a logistic map leaving period-1 and bifurcating into chaos. Around 112 BPM, Bb minor. Start with a single dry analog note repeating; it splits into two, then four, then a cloud of noise ticks, then a strange but stable groove. Precise, not random-noise music. Instrumental only. No vocals, no choir, no lyrics, no hummed melody-as-voice, no singing, no whispered speech. No dubstep bass, no trailer drums.

[00:00–00:20] One analog pitch, even eighths, dead-dry.
[00:20–00:50] Pitch alternates two values; a second percussion tick appears.
[00:50–01:20] Four-value cycle; piano adds dissonant neighbor tones.
[01:20–01:55] Texture becomes irregular but bounded; noise ticks like sensitive dependence.
[01:55–02:30] A new quieter period-3-like cell emerges, then cuts to one note.
